verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a first-party Approvals feature: members can request approval for a flag change from a member or team in their project, which delivers the core change-request workflow. The evidence describes approval as an option the requester chooses, and it never shows that approvals can be mandated for a specific environment such as production. Missing for 10: documented enforcement that makes approvals mandatory for production environment changes, detail on approval workflow configuration (reviewer counts, bypass rules), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: they have the option to request approval for that change from a member or team in their LaunchDarkly project.
Environments allow you to manage your feature flags throughout your entire development lifecycle, from local development through production.
